module: "Advanced Lighting" light manager. Loads the submodules shaders, lightViz and shadowViz, then, if the manager exists (LightManager.findByName), publishes the global table ADVLMCallbacks with onActivate/onDeactivate. On activation, it enables the AL_FormatToken object (off-screen target needed for MSAA and HDR); on deactivation, it disables it.
notes: The $pref::LightManager::* preferences block at the start is entirely commented out.
